title: Repository application plan for claude-swift-toolkit
key_findings: The truthful Codex surface now includes the four lifecycle plugins: apple-app-architect, apple-design-system, apple-app-builder, and apple-app-quality.

apple-app-builder and apple-app-quality now bundle plugin-local .mcp.json files that launch the official Xcode MCP bridge via xcrun mcpbridge, making their Xcode-backed build and test workflows explicit in the Codex package.
hookify currently depends on Claude-specific commands, agents, and hooks and does not expose a Codex-ready skill, app, or MCP surface.

The least-risk transformation remains a dual-host rollout: keep the Claude-first structure intact, use Codex-facing wrapper skill trees only where host behavior diverges, and document hookify as Claude-only.
recommended_actions: Keep the repo marketplace aligned with the full Codex-supported lifecycle plugin set.
Update the root README with Codex installation steps, the current support matrix, and the official Xcode MCP bridge prerequisite notes for builder and quality workflows.
Record the research synthesis in-repo so future plugin changes can reuse the migration rationale.
